description: The boards a Pinterest account's Pins can go to, and the one a post uses when options.pinterest.board_id is left out: the account's default board (picked at connect as its board with the most Pins), else its busiest board. An account with no boards gets one named new_board with its first Pin, so a post never has to pick. account_settings_update pinterest_board_id changes the default.
name: pinterest_boards
title: Pinterest boards
